描述_EN: porcelain ewer inscribed with 'wan fu you tong' (may all happiness gather there) within a double circle in blue. on either side is painted a fountain of european style, a border of waves around the foot, plantain leaves on the neck and flowers on the handle and spout. it has a bulbous body with long curved neck and flaring mouth, loop handle with small ring at the top for attachment of a chain to secure the (missing) lid.
描述_ZN: 瓷器的蓝色双圈内刻有 "万福有余"。 两侧绘有欧洲风格的喷泉，脚下有波浪边框，颈部有芭蕉叶，把手和壶嘴有花。 它有一个球状的身体，长弯曲的脖子和扇形的嘴，环形的手柄，顶部有小环，可以连接链子来固定（缺失的）盖子。
